inputs.text:
A lavish giant SKY TREE MERCHANT SHIP floating high above a deep sea of soft white clouds, a beautiful 9:16 portrait background illustration for a cheerful sky-fantasy mobile RPG. ONE enormous ornate wooden trading vessel replaces the mountaintop harbor as the upper-background point of interest. There is no land harbor or dock. The merchant vessel is like a magnificent traveling market with an ancient living tree growing from its deck.

CAMERA AND LAYOUT: bird's-eye three-quarter view, looking steeply DOWN at the vessel from a 60-degree angle, near-orthographic isometric game perspective. The wide deck floors and barrel tops are clearly visible from ABOVE. No horizon, no eye-level side view. The long ship runs diagonally from the stern at upper-left to the ornate pointed bow at lower-right. Place the giant merchant ship primarily across the UPPER TWO THIRDS of the portrait, stretching almost across the full width with a comfortable margin, all hull tips and flags fully inside the frame. Leave the LOWER THIRD as quiet open blue atmospheric depth and billowing clouds, so a separate player vessel can be added there later. Only the huge merchant vessel is drawn, no second ship. This is a background composition, without UI.

SHIP DESIGN: an immense broad-bellied amber and honey-brown wooden galleon with multiple terraced cargo decks, heavy curved timber ribs, beautifully readable individual planks, brass corner plates, carved golden leaf scrollwork along the hull, large round brass portholes and robust warm wooden railings. A grand two-story timber merchant cabin at the stern, small orange-red tiled roofs, warm windows, elaborate gold-trimmed roof corners, a wooden loading crane and a few small side propellers. One magnificent mature tree grows from a circular brass-bound wooden planter in the rear half of the main deck. It has a thick twisting brown trunk and a broad lush layered crown of luminous lime-green and yellow-green leaves. Keep the tree crown in the upper portion, leaving most of the cargo deck clearly visible.

ABUNDANT TRADE CARGO: the forward and central decks are densely and visibly packed with MANY round wooden barrel casks bound by dark iron hoops, and MANY varied wooden trade crates with diagonal bracing, rope bindings and small simple decorative trade seals. Neatly piled crates of different sizes, clusters of upright and sideways barrels, rope coils, a few colorful cloth-wrapped parcels and compact red and teal market awnings. It must look richly stocked and prosperous, with dozens of readable cargo shapes and narrow access paths. All barrels and boxes rest naturally on the deck, without floating objects.

FLAGS AND ANCHOR: several spectacular colorful silk banners and long fluttering pennants, rich crimson, royal blue, emerald teal and warm gold trim, simple golden leaf emblems with NO letters. Place banners on short poles around the stern and railings, with decorative small pennant strings overhead. No large sails obscuring the deck or tree. A conspicuous HUGE traditional dark iron anchor with polished golden fittings hangs from a thick chain on the visible right/bow side of the hull, fully visible against the pale clouds below. Give the anchor a strong clear curved fluke silhouette and a real chain attachment to the hull.

STYLE: polished premium hand-painted 2D fantasy game illustration, sculpted rounded volumes, rich detailed painterly shading, crisp readable timber shapes, warm sunshine from upper-left, bright lively saturated greens and gold, softly shaded wood grain, airy blue shadows, charming chunky game proportions. Match a cozy wooden flying-ship game with a bright green tree. Strong sense of immense height: only empty air under the hull and white cloud layers far below, a few tiny distant blue mountain pinnacles through the haze near the edges. No ocean and no water surface. Edge-to-edge portrait art. No people, no characters, no readable text, no UI, no buttons, no title, no border, no watermark. One gigantic cargo-laden sky-tree merchant ship with extravagant flags and a prominent hanging anchor, viewed from above.
